sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Pankaj Satsangi,Praveen Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Suresh Kumar Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This revision has been filed by revisionist against the order dated 14.08.2018 passed by Sri Surendra Pal Singh, Sessions Judge, Rampur in Criminal Appeal No. 46 of 2017 by means of which the Court below has confirmed/upheld the judgment and order dated 24.08.2017 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Rampur in Criminal Case No. 56 of 2011 (State Vs. Krishna Gopal and another) under Section 7/16 (1)(a)(i) and 7/16 (1)(a)(ii) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954, P.S.- Bilaspur, District Rampur by means of which the Court below has convicted and sentenced the revisionist under Section 7/16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954 for 2 years rigorous imprisonment alongwith a fine of Rs. 2000/- and in the event of default of payment of fine the revisionist would have to undergo 2 months extra rigorous imprisonment and under Section 7/16(1)(a)(i) for 2 years rigorous imprisonment along with a fine of Rs. 2000/-(Rs.
two thousand) and in the event of default of payment of fine the revisionist would have to undergo 2 months extra rigorous imprisonment and under section 7/16(1)(a)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for 6 months rigorous imprisonment alongwith fine of Rs.1000/- (Rs. one Krishna Gopal vs State Of U.P. on 14 October, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101171395/
1 thousand) and in the event of default of payment of fine the revisionist would have to undergo 1 month extra rigorous imprisonment.

sentences.text: And all the sentences would run concurrently.

Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted that this revision has been filed by the revisionist on 14.09.2018 and a prayer for bail is also sought by the revisionist till the decision of the revision.

Learned counsel for the revisionist further contended that the bail prayer of the revisionist is still pending and also prayed that revisionist is in jail since 14.08.2018 and revisionist has been in jail for more than 14 months, hence in these circumstances this Court may take a lenient view and graciously modify the sentence awarded to him for the period undergone alongwith fine.

Considering the law laid down by Apex Court in Ankush Shivaji Gaikwad Versus State of Maharashtra (arising out of S.L.P. (CRl.) No. 6287 of 2011, this Hon'ble court may take a view of leniency and graciously modified the sentence awarded to revisionists to the period already undergone alongwith fine.

entities.text: Ankush Shivaji Gaikwad Versus State of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case this Hon'ble Court finds it desirable to enhance the fine, the revisionists will not treat the same as enhancement of sentence.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case alongwith the case law cited above, I am of the view that sentence for the impugned order dated 14.08.2018 is desired to be modified suitably.

Sentence part of the order is modified to the extent that the revisionist sentenced for the period of sentence undergone and the fine already ordered by the Court below which will be deposited by the revisionist forthwith.
After depositing the fine the revisionist will be released immediately.
In case of a failure to deposit the fine as directed above he will serve out the remainder of sentence.
A copy of this order be communicated to the Court below for necessary compliance.
The revision is disposed of to the aforesaid extent.

Order Date :- 14.10.2019 Ashok Gupta  Krishna Gopal vs State Of U.P. on 14 October, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101171395/
